description: Partially update a menu item: only the given fields are sent and changed, every other stored field (type, linked object, url, ...) is kept (cvrt-mcp-endpoints 1.14.2+). The linked object (type/object/object_id) cannot be changed here: delete the item and add a new one. The response lists the changed fields.

classes.description: CSS classes, space- or comma-separated (replaces the stored list; empty string clears)

description.description: Item description (shown by themes that render menu descriptions)

parent.description: Parent menu item ID (an item of the same menu; 0 = top level)

status.description: publish = visible, draft = hidden from the menu

target.description: Link target: "_blank" opens in a new tab, "" in the same tab

title.description: Menu item label (empty string = follow the linked page's title)

url.description: Link URL. Only allowed on custom links; a page/term item answers 400 url_not_custom

xfn.description: Link relationship (XFN rel values), space-separated, e.g. "nofollow noopener"

name: mcp_update_menu_item
